title: ‘Risk Your Life To Race’: Wrong-Way Police Motorbike Hits Pidcock’s Teammates
content:
Pidcock nearly quit after a police motorbike hit his teammates at Tre Valli, a day after a delivery van entered the race course at Coppa Bernocchi.

Read the full article at ‘Risk Your Life To Race’: Wrong-Way Police Motorbike Hits Pidcock’s Teammates on Velo.
